items.exampleEn: It was unfortunate that it rained on our wedding day.
items.exampleZh: 很不幸，我們結婚那天下雨了。

items.exampleEn: He has been a faithful friend to me since childhood.
items.exampleZh: 他從小就是我忠誠的朋友。

items.exampleEn: Everyone is hopeful that the new park will open soon.
items.exampleZh: 大家都盼望新公園能早日開放。

items.exampleEn: The size of the old tree stunned the visitors.
items.exampleZh: 那棵老樹的大小讓遊客們目瞪口呆。

items.exampleEn: The children feel great affection for their swimming teacher.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們非常喜愛他們的游泳老師。

items.exampleEn: The old bridge trembled as the heavy truck went over it.
items.exampleZh: 重型卡車開過時，那座舊橋在顫動。

items.exampleEn: His eyes were full of hatred.

items.sentenceEn: The customer was not satisfied with the food.
items.sentenceZh: 那位客人對食物不滿意。

items.audioEn: The ending of the movie stunned everyone. Nobody expected the hero to be the bad guy.
items.audioZh: 電影的結局讓所有人都震驚了，沒人想到主角竟然是壞人。
options: The hero turned out to be the bad guy.

items.sentenceEn: The leaves trembled in the wind.
I feel hopeful about the future.

items.stemEn: Our ____ old car has never broken down in twenty years.
items.stemZh: 我們那輛忠實可靠的老車，二十年來從沒壞過。

items.stemEn: Her voice began to ____ as she told us the sad news.
items.stemZh: 她告訴我們這個悲傷的消息時，聲音開始顫抖。

items.passageEn: My grandpa has had a faithful dog named Bobo for fifteen years. Last winter, something unfortunate happened: Bobo got lost in the snow. Grandpa's hands trembled as he called the neighbors. We searched all night, and the night felt endless. The next morning, we were still hopeful. Then a farmer called: he had found Bobo in his garden! The news stunned us, because Bobo was ten kilometers away. When Grandpa saw Bobo, he hugged him with great affection. Now Grandpa takes Bobo for a walk every morning, and he is satisfied as long as Bobo is by his side.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺養了一隻忠誠的狗，名叫 Bobo，已經十五年了。去年冬天發生了一件不幸的事：Bobo 在雪中走失了。爺爺打電話給鄰居時雙手在發抖。我們找了一整夜，那一夜感覺沒完沒了。第二天早上，我們仍然抱著希望。接著一位農夫打電話來：他在自家院子裡找到了 Bobo！這個消息讓我們都驚呆了，因為 Bobo 在十公里外。爺爺看到 Bobo 時，充滿喜愛地抱住了牠。現在，爺爺每天早上都帶 Bobo 去散步，只要 Bobo 在身邊，他就很滿足。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺打電話給鄰居時怎麼了？
為什麼大家聽到消息很驚訝？
options: 因為 Bobo 自己走回家了
因為農夫是爺爺的老朋友
因為 Bobo 受了重傷
因為 Bobo 在十公里外被找到

items.promptZh: 仇恨只會帶來更多仇恨。
referenceEn: Hatred brings nothing but more hatred.
rubricZh: hatred 表示「仇恨」，例如 full of hatred 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 satisfied 造一個句子，說說一件你感到滿意的事。
referenceEn: I am satisfied with my English grade this term.
I was satisfied with the cake I made for my mom.
rubricZh: satisfied 表示「滿意的」，例如 be satisfied with… 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或過去式等）
